description: Filters a vMIDI stream by channel, restamps it onto one channel, splits it at a note and transposes it

inputs.text: Takes the vMIDI stream to be processed; a message on a channel the IN CHAN setting rejects goes no further

outputs.text: Carries notes below the KEY SPLIT note while key split is on, and nothing at all while it is off
Carries every message that gets through, apart from notes below the KEY SPLIT note while key split is on

notes: the four black displays are the controls, and none of them can be clicked for help
hover over the IN CHAN display and scroll to choose the channel accepted; ALL takes every channel, CH 01 to CH 16 take only that one
hover over the OUT CHAN display and scroll to choose the channel every outgoing message is restamped with, CH 01 to CH 16
hover over the KEY SPLIT display and scroll to set the split note, 36 to 84; double-click the display to switch key split off and on without losing the note, and it reads OFF while off
hover over the TRANS display and scroll to transpose the output, -24 to +24 semitones; transposing happens after the split, so it never moves a note to the other output
changing any of the four settings sends a note off for every note this module has already sent, so a held note does not hang
system messages are not filtered by channel and are not transposed; they go out of the R jack whatever key split is doing
